title: Chewy Lemon Blondies
changes_from_base: Lots of lemon zest in the dough and a crunchy lemon-sugar top; no chocolate.
summary: Chewy blondies flavoured with plenty of lemon zest and finished with lemon sugar.
equipment: 23 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling
electric hand whisk or wooden spoon

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Lemon sugar
steps.text: Get the oven going at 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line a 23 cm square tin with paper. Rub the 25 g sugar with the zest of one lemon between your fingertips until fragrant.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the melted butter with both sugars and the salt, then the egg, yolk, remaining zest and lemon flavouring.

steps.title: Flour
steps.text: Stir in the flour and bicarbonate of soda to a thick dough and press it evenly into the tin.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Sprinkle the lemon sugar over and bake 25-30 min, until the edges are golden and the centre is just set.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin, then cut into 16.

tips: Zest the lemons before juicing or cutting them.
Rubbing the zest into the sugar releases more lemon oil.
Pull them while the centre still looks soft.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
